content: AI coding agent orchestrator architecture pattern: a top-level orchestrator process holds full context (tasks, worktrees, branches), spawns isolated worker sessions each in its own git worktree/branch so agents never touch the same files concurrently, and merges via per-agent PR review (never automated merge). Practical scale is 2-5 parallel agents without dedicated infra, up to 10+ with tmux/headless automation. This maps directly to PixelFirm's control-plane orchestrator + worker-per-repo model.
